2026-11-10 14:47:59.867383 | controller |
2026-11-10 14:47:59.867387 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-10 14:47:59.867395 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's

2026-11-10 14:47:59.867402 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-10 14:47:59.867406 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-10 14:47:59.869959 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-10 14:47:59.869967 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
